digest.component_or_area: completion verify workflow / LLM recovery gate
propositions: When a completion verify run has banked an operator-actionable BLOCK criterion (met=False with evidence_sufficient not False) and then encounters a provider outage (LLMUnavailableError), the gate must finalize a deterministic BLOCK verdict from the bank instead of dying verdict-less, with zero further LLM calls.

The banked BLOCK degrade verdict is always FAIL with certifiable=False and finalizer=deterministic_fallback, which flows to close_precheck's non-close branch (returncode 1) to surface findings for operator decision without auto-closing the ticket.

An empty criterion bank or a bank containing only PASSes and insufficiency placeholders (no actionable BLOCK) must re-raise the LLMUnavailableError unchanged to preserve the exit-11 retryable-retry posture per ADR 0040.

The degrade logic in CompletionAgentStep.run's except LLMUnavailableError arm is guarded so any fault (bank read error, unreadable ticket) falls through to re-raise, ensuring the degrade is an enhancement never a new failure mode on the outage path.

A new bank_has_actionable_block predicate (met=False AND not insufficient) is added to completion_verdict_assembly and re-exported through completion_banking to support the degrade decision and provide a stable bank-entry vocabulary.

Retryable errors retain bounded retries with backoff and emit a clear operator message on terminal exhaustion via the existing exit-11 'transient — retry' surface (ADR 0040 unchanged, no amendment); sustained-outage detection was rejected in the operator decision.
